test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On: 25 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The Ganga plain extend between which two rivers?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ghaggar and Teesta.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Ganga Plain which lies between **Ghaggar and Teesta** rivers is characterized by quaternary alluvia with combinations of clay, silt, sand, and gravel.
 
• The states,** of Haryana, Delhi, UP, Bihar, part of Jharkhand, and West Bengal** lie in the Ganga plains.
 
• This plain covers most of the part of Northern Plains.
 
• The Ganga plain stretches from** Delhi to Kolkata** covering about** 3.7 lakh sq km**.
 
• The peninsular rivers like** Ken, Chambal, Betwa, Son,** etc. joining the Ganga river system contributed to the formation of this plain.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• India is divided into six main parts that are The Great Mountain Range, Northern Plains, Desert Region, Peninsular Plateaus, Coastal Plains, and Island group. 
 
• The total geographical area of India is** 3.28 million square km**.
 
• The longest river in India is** Ganga** which is** 2,525 km** long.
 
• India has the** 18th largest Exclusive Economic Zone** of** 2,305,143 km2 (890,021 sq mi)**.
 
• India has **7,516 km** long coastline. Canada has the longest coastline in the world.
